name: Demon Bazooka
summary: A compact 3D arena shooter: a lone soldier on a circular hellscape fends off escalating waves of imps, winged demons and bosses with splash-damage rockets, dashes and a screen-clearing barrage. All graphics and audio are generated by code at runtime.

name: Gravity Wave
summary: An endless 3D flight shooter through procedurally generated canyons and alien biomes, threading guide lanes, breaking enemy formations and hunting biome guardians to an original synthwave soundtrack.

name: Adjustris
summary: A falling-block puzzler where you tune the rules yourself: well size, speed and piece set.

name: Big2Small
summary: Steer an elephant, a goat and a mouse through farm mazes, using each animal's size to clear the way for the others.

name: Carazu
summary: A small platformer written in assembly: hop across floating ledges and dodge the creatures in your way.

name: Dawn Will Come
summary: Scavenge a ruined city at night with a small band of survivors, keeping the fire going until sunrise.

name: GB Corp.
summary: Run an office of tiny workers who need fresh batteries; swapping the cartridge to another Game Boy model recharges them all.

name: Gigant Golf
summary: A giant tees off across hills and towns, lining up each long shot with wind and terrain in mind.

name: Libbet and the Magic Floor
summary: Roll a ball-shaped girl over every tile of each basement floor; plan the route or get stuck.

name: Rhythm Land
summary: A string of quick rhythm mini-games in a seaside town: keep the beat to feed seagulls, skate and more.

name: Skeleton Crew
summary: Lead a party of skeletons through a turn-based dungeon crawl, levelling up their skills between fights.

name: Sushi Nights
summary: Swing across a neon city on a grappling hook as a sheep courier racing to deliver sushi before it goes cold.

name: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe
summary: Bounce off flying creatures to climb ever higher and bring a runaway cat home. A colour remaster of the original Game Boy arcade platformer.

name: 2048 Advance
summary: Slide numbered tiles together to reach 2048, with smooth animations and saved high scores.

name: Apotris
summary: A fast, highly customisable falling-block game with sprint, marathon and versus modes.

name: HEXES
summary: Fend off hexagon-shaped foes in a tiny arena by matching your shot to the number each one shows.

name: Skyland
summary: Build and defend a flying island fortress in real-time battles against sky pirates, then grow it into a floating city.

name: Solar Guard
summary: Pilot a patrol fighter clearing space junk and raiders from orbit, refitting the ship between missions.
license: GPL-3.0 (code and original assets) + OpenGameArt assets under their own free licenses

name: Aevilia
summary: An unfinished but playable top-down RPG demo for the Game Boy Color, with an open-source engine and hand-drawn sprites.

name: Airaki
summary: Match tiles to power your attacks in a puzzle RPG, levelling up between battles.

name: Geometrix
summary: Swap coloured shapes to make lines and clear the board, with timed and limited-move modes.

name: Rebound
summary: Bounce a springy blue ball through grassy caves, collecting coins and timing each hop.

name: uCity
summary: A complete city-building sim on a Game Boy Color cartridge: zone land, lay roads and power, and keep the budget afloat.

name: Dragon's Castle
summary: A young witch named Merlina climbs through a dragon-infested castle, fighting with her broom and magic in this side-scrolling platformer demo.

name: Gnome Runner
summary: An endless runner in which a little gnome dashes through a forest and jumps over obstacles for a high score.

name: KleleAtoms MD
summary: A turn-based chain-reaction strategy game: drop atoms on a grid, overload cells so they burst into neighbours, and capture every opposing atom. Supports AI and mouse.

name: Lunch Break
summary: During your lunch break you walk the street persuading fellow workers to join a union while dodging your boss.

name: Miniplanets
summary: A platformer where you run and jump around tiny spherical planets to rescue Qisha's children; this is the 2022 REMIX version with upgraded graphics and music.

name: Retail Clerk '89
summary: A top-down adventure set in a late-1980s shopping mall, where you work a retail job, talk to customers and coworkers and finish small story tasks.
license: MIT (code) + CC-BY-SA-4.0 (characters, story, art); third-party fonts/tiles/music under listed permissive terms

name: 8-Bit Table Tennis
summary: A two-player table tennis game in the spirit of early paddle games: serve, rally and race to 11 points.

name: Concentration Room
summary: A memory card-matching game set in a lab accident: flip tiles to find pairs, solo or against a friend or the CPU.
license: GPL-3.0-or-later (with exception for unmodified ROM distribution)

name: Falling
summary: An endless arcade game in which you steer a falling character through the sky, dodging obstacles and grabbing pickups as the speed ramps up.

name: RHDE: Furniture Fight
summary: A real-time strategy game about home decorating: build and furnish your house with falling-block shaped pieces, then battle a rival household.
license: GNU All-Permissive License (as stated in README/LICENSE.txt)

name: RoboRun
summary: A single-screen platformer written in C where a small robot collects coins and stars across several levels while avoiding enemies (PAL/Dendy only).

name: robotfindskitten
summary: An NES take on the classic 'Zen simulation': guide a robot around a field of odd symbols, inspecting each one until you find the kitten.

name: Super Tilt Bro.
summary: A platform fighter for the NES where two characters brawl on floating stages, trying to knock each other off the screen; includes a CPU opponent and story mode.

name: Thwaite
summary: A missile-defense style game where you protect a small town's houses from incoming missiles by firing interceptors from two silos.

name: ZorchenRunner
summary: An endless runner developed live on stream: jump over obstacles as the city scrolls past, with seedable levels and a high-score table.

name: Blox
summary: A falling-blocks puzzle game written in assembly for the PC Engine in 1999 and later re-released with source.
A Master System version of the sliding-tile number puzzle: merge equal tiles to reach 2048. Made for the SMS Power! 2014 competition.

name: Data Storm
summary: A high-speed lane shooter: move up and down a central corridor and blast the aliens racing along the side lanes. Entry for the SMS Power! 2016 competition.

name: Duckslayer Adventures
summary: Sir Jelly, a gelatinous cube, explores castles and mazes to recover a chalice guarded by duck-dragons. An SMS Power! 2018 competition entry.

name: Lander 2
summary: A lunar-lander style game: take off, steer a small rocket through cave levels with limited fuel and land on the pads. SMS Power! 2015 competition entry.

name: Raposa do Sol
summary: A fast arena game: fly around each screen collecting satellites against the clock while turrets fire at you.

name: Space Tonbow
summary: An arcade score-attack shooter where a mechanical dragonfly dashes into swarming enemy orbs; it can also be played in vertical TATE mode and uses FM sound if present.

name: Gothicvania
summary: A short side-scrolling action-platformer demo through a haunted graveyard, fighting skeletons, ghosts and hell-cats with a sword.

name: Super Apocalux
summary: A bare-bones endless rooftop runner: a lone survivor jumps between city buildings toward the setting sun for a high score.

name: A World of One-Way
summary: A 16K sliding puzzle: every move sends the hero and all the skeletons on screen gliding until they hit a wall, so you must herd enemies into bombs and acid, smash crates and reach the exit; coins buy extra lives or level passwords between stages. Written for the ASM-2021 compo.

name: Cheman
summary: A metalhead has to fight his way through a neighbourhood overrun by batucada drummers to reach a concert, stomping the drummers and carrying power medallions back to totems across two flip-screen stages.

name: No Future
summary: A fixed-screen shooter where aliens pour out of a sky portal to steal Earth's water and oxygen; shoot them before they carry the resources back up, while your H2O and O2 meters drain. Supports Kempston/Fuller joysticks and Fuller AY sound.

name: ParaZXland
summary: Jump from a wobbling helicopter and steer a parachutist through drifting anti-grav mines and gusting ocean winds to land on a tiny island; each successful drop adds more mines. Written in pure Boriel ZX Basic for the ByteManiacos BASIC compo 2023.

A rookie defender of 'The Net' descends into sewer-like dungeons full of rats, spiders and carnivorous plants to patch the cracks dark forces have opened, answering a sphinx's riddles along the way. Sequel in spirit to 6.6.6.6; released as an alpha build.

A tongue-in-cheek tech-support adventure: each job has you racing a bike along a winding road against the clock, then answering a multiple-choice question, with five attempts to keep The Net from collapsing.
